basic.name: Jordan Zhou
basic.headline: Frontend Engineer | B2B Products and Design Systems
basic.summary: Four years building B2B workspaces, design systems, and reliable delivery.

highlights: Rebuilt permission and form infrastructure, reducing critical-flow errors by 31%.

Set performance and release budgets, improving first paint by 38% and cutting defects by 42%.

highlights: Coordinated design and six product teams to upgrade more than 40 pages with zero downtime.

basic.name: Evelyn Zhao
basic.headline: VP, Product & Engineering | Enterprise Software
basic.summary: Enterprise software executive scaling product portfolios, teams, and recurring revenue.

highlights: Directed a 48-person product, design, and engineering organization; reorganized 14 squads into five outcome portfolios and grew annual recurring revenue by 32%.
Introduced quarterly planning and service-level objectives, raising release predictability from 72% to 91% and reducing severity-one incidents by 44%.
Expanded revenue from CNY 180M to CNY 460M while improving gross margin by 11 percentage points.

project.name: Enterprise Operating Model Transformation
highlights: Reduced duplicate investment by 21% and shortened cross-functional decisions from six weeks to 12 days.
